terms.purpose: Use what people write and their nicknames only to support them, and never share them
terms.inApp: Talk inside the app and don't ask for the person's contact details

contrib.title: My contributions
contrib.formula: Score = number of indicators on solved requests × number of people affected. Requests from individuals count as 1 person; company and community requests use the registered number of people. Only indicators confirmed by the samasama team count, and thanks are counted separately. Only support confirmed as solved by the person asking counts — not the number of offers or reply speed. The indicators are based on the SDG global indicators, but this way of counting was set by samasama on its own and is not defined or endorsed by the United Nations or others.
contrib.keep: These records stay even if your affiliation changes. The content of requests is not kept (only indicators and your affiliation at the time). Everything is deleted if you leave.
contrib.thanksArrived: Thanks from the person who asked
contrib.resolvedRecord: {count, plural, =0 {A request was solved} one {A request was solved (# confirmed indicator)} other {A request was solved (# confirmed indicators)}}

org.membersTip: Requests and messages belong to the organization. Only current members can read them; removed members lose access from that day. Contribution records stay with each person.
